changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('[reporting].[Global_Resource]') AND [name] = 'uid') begin alter table reporting.Global_resource add [uid] uniqueidentifier; end
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('[reporting].[Global_Resource]') AND [name] = 'uid') begin alter table reporting.Global_resource drop column [uid]; end

changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql:
--need to populate the uid's with something until the job picks it up so we can make it not null --newid() is a fail safe, I doubt it's needed update R set R.[uid] = coalesce(A.[uid], newid()) from reporting.Global_resource R left join Asset A on A.Object = 'Resource' and A.ObjectID = R.ResourceID;
alter table reporting.Global_resource alter column [uid] uniqueidentifier not null;

changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql: drop trigger if exists [reporting].[ReportingGlobalResource_AfterInsert]; drop trigger if exists [reporting].[ReportingGlobalResource_AfterUpsert];

changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER [reporting].[ReportingGlobalResource_AfterUpsert] ON [reporting].[Global_Resource] FOR INSERT, UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM DELETED) BEGIN INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Add', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'Resource', ResourceID, 0), 'Resource', ResourceID from inserted; END
merge dbo.Asset as T using ( SELECT T.ID as AssetTypeID, 1 as [State], O.ResourceID as SourceID, 'Resource' as Object, O.ResourceID as ObjectID, O.[uid] FROM inserted O inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'ResourceType' and T.ObjectID = 1 ) as S on (T.Object = S.Object and T.ObjectID = S.ObjectID) when matched then update set T.[uid] = S.[uid], T.UpdatedOn = getutcdate(), T.UpdatedBy = 0 when not matched by target then insert ([AssetTypeID], [State], SourceID, [Object], [ObjectID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedOn],[UpdatedBy],[uid]) values (S.[AssetTypeID], S.[State], S.SourceID, S.[Object], S.[ObjectID], getutcdate(), 0, getutcdate(), 0, S.[uid]);
changeSet.rollback:
CREATE TRIGGER [reporting].[ReportingGlobalResource_AfterInsert] ON [reporting].[Global_Resource] FOR INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Add', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'Resource', ResourceID, 0), 'Resource', ResourceID from inserted;
merge dbo.Asset as T using ( SELECT T.ID as AssetTypeID, 1 as [State], O.ResourceID as SourceID, 'Resource' as Object, O.ResourceID as ObjectID FROM inserted O inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'ResourceType' and T.ObjectID = 1 ) as S on (T.Object = S.Object and T.ObjectID = S.ObjectID) when matched then update set T.UpdatedOn = getutcdate(), T.UpdatedBy = 0 when not matched by target then insert ([AssetTypeID], [State], SourceID, [Object], [ObjectID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedOn],[UpdatedBy]) values (S.[AssetTypeID], S.[State], S.SourceID, S.[Object], S.[ObjectID], getutcdate(), 0, getutcdate(), 0);
